info:
A good beginner rule is:

Imperfective Future (быть + infinitive)
Use it when emphasizing the activity, process, duration, or repetition.

Я буду читать. — I will be reading.
Она будет работать завтра. — She will be working tomorrow.
Мы будем гулять. — We will be walking.
Think:
What will someone be doing?

Perfective Future (simple future form)
Use it when emphasizing a single completed action, result, or event.

Я скажу это завтра. — I will say it tomorrow.
Он съест позже. — He will eat later.
Мы засмеёмся, если будет смешно. — We will laugh if it's funny.
Think:
What will happen?
